15:14 Local Time, 13:14 GMT, 18:44 IST: Australia with the upper hand here in Cape Town! Their last two wickets managed to stretch the lead to 100 and then their pacers extracted life out of this abrasive pitch. There was movement with the new ball with Hazlewood, in particular, being right on the money. Some unevenness from the surface also coming into the picture now. The ball which dismissed Markram seemed to stop on him as he went to play on the up. South Africa still trailing by 47 and the heat is on them, as can be seen in some of the running between the wickets and shot-selection. Back shortly for the final session.
